request.name: Get triggered action and webhook logs

description.content:
Return the status and details of webhooks and/or triggered actions. By default, results are in ascending order by log ID.
Note if the user does not have the "View all data" permission, all potentially sensitive data will be redacted (replaced with the text "\"). Note also that a triggered action wil typically produce two entries in the log: one for querying associated data and one for executing the HTTP request.

query.description: Max number of results to return. Default: 200
A Webhook or Triggered Action ID to filter on
If true, includes only webhook logs. If false, includes only triggered action logs. If omitted, includes logs of both types.
Return logs updated after this datetime (inclusive)
Return logs updated before this datetime (inclusive)
Sort order for the results. Results are sorted by log ID, which corresponds to the order in which they were triggered.
